name: us_2026ytd
label: United States 2026 year-to-date (Jan-Oct/Nov 2026, from the live feed; 9 of 20 features)

term_spread.source: DGS10 minus DFF annual means (JST stir for the US is a 3-month bill rate; the funds rate is used as the short-rate proxy, levels within ~10 bp in 2025)

real_ltrate_expost.source: DGS10 annual mean minus CPI-U annual-average inflation

debt_gdp.source: FRED GFDEGDQ188S, 2 observations 2026-01-01..2026-04-01, annual mean (data/fred/GFDEGDQ188S.csv) / 100 (same series concept as JST debtgdp: 2020 FRED 128.1 vs JST 1.281)

d5_debt_gdp.source: GFDEGDQ188S 2026 mean / 100 minus JST USA 2020 debtgdp 1.281

real_eq_capgain_3y.source: SP500 annual mean 2026 / 2023, deflated by CPIAUCSL annual means, annualized over 3 years (annual-average basis, as JST)
